text:
New York has overtaken California as the top destination for international students.

California’s international student population fell 5.8% last school year, more than twice the national decline. Texas’ rose 1.9%.

author: chronicle.com
text: Opinion: A defense of higher education that focuses only on its political enemies can miss the harder question: why universities became so vulnerable in the first place. https://chroni.cl/3X6fXLb

author: chronicle.com
text: Opinion: Submissions to a major AI conference grew from 490 for 2017 to more than 62,000 for 2027. Peer review was strained before generative AI. The author argues journals and conferences may need a new friction point: submission fees. https://chroni.cl/4AvYOJq

author: chronicle.com
text: The number of institutions with larger shares of students with disabilities, defined as 10 percent or more, has surged. In 2023, more than 17 percent of institutions enrolled such shares, up from just 2 percent in 2008. www.chronicle.com/article/the-...

author: chronicle.com
text: The share of college students with registered disabilities nearly doubled from 2004 to 2020. The debate over accommodations is growing, but the reporting shows a more complicated reality: skepticism, paperwork, costs, and overwhelmed disability offices. https://chroni.cl/4ken26b

author: chronicle.com
text: York College is poised to buy Penn State’s soon-to-close York campus for $7.4 million, pending trustee approval Friday. The plan would tap unrestricted endowment funds and bring in WellSpan Health as an anchor tenant. https://chroni.cl/4zLXlPh
